get_include: get the pybind11 include directory path for C++ extension builds
get_cmake_dir: get the pybind11 cmake configuration directory path
build_extension_include: build a C++ extension by retrieving the pybind11 include path with get_include
setup_cmake_pybind11: setup cmake build by retrieving the pybind11 cmake directory with get_cmake_dir
test_get_include: test the get_include function to verify it returns the correct include path
